name: The manna hoarders
charge: Keeping manna overnight; going out to gather on the Sabbath
summary: Told to gather only a day's portion, some kept manna until morning and it bred worms and stank. Told there would be none on the seventh day, some went out to gather anyway and found nothing.
offense: Distrust dressed as prudence. The first was hoarding against a promise of daily provision; the second was Sabbath-breaking against a double portion already given. Moses was angry at the one, and the Lord at the other: how long refuse ye to keep my commandments?
judgment: The hoarded bread rotted. The Sabbath gatherers went out and found nothing, and were rebuked. Small, exact, and recorded so the next test would be understood.
